description: This file defines the YieldNotReadyExtension class in the Twig extension namespace, which provides a node visitor related to yield readiness in Twig templates.

classes.name: Twig\Extension\YieldNotReadyExtension
classes.description: A Twig extension class that registers a node visitor to handle yield not ready scenarios in Twig templates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the extension with a boolean flag indicating whether to use yield.

methods.name: getNodeVisitors
methods.description: Returns an array containing an instance of YieldNotReadyNodeVisitor configured with the useYield flag.
